The software product **GetWebsite.Report** at **getwebsite.report** is provided directly under the brand/entity **GetWebsite.Report**, built and operated by founder and developer **Sankeerth Julapally**.

### Evidence:
* The official website footer states: *"© 2025 GetWebsite.Report. All rights reserved"* with direct contact at `support@getwebsite.report`.
* Developer disclosures and software directory registries identify Sankeerth Julapally as the creator and operator: *"I built https://getwebsite.report"* (Peerlist / Reddit) and *"GetWebsite.Report was submitted by Sankeerth Julapally from GetWebsite.Report"* (Crozdesk).
